output.english_question: Can UCB levy pre-payment charges on a cash credit facility if the borrower informs the bank before the stipulated period that it will not renew, and the facility is closed on the due date?
sub_queries: UCB prepayment charges cash credit facility renewal not renewed closed on due date

premises: The facility is a cash credit/overdraft type (cash credit facility) and it is closed on the due date.
The borrower provided notice to the bank before the stipulated period that it would not renew.
UCB is proposing to levy pre-payment charges in this scenario.
